connector.meaning: Listed by the request reader but not used: the stop reads all HDMI connectors.

dry-run.meaning: Listed by the request reader but not used by this read; the front door does not admit a dry-run field here.

observed.meaning: HDMI state: connector inventory, managed files, live forced-link state and pending boot configuration. The front door supplies null when the stop refused before providing a state.

connectors.meaning: Connector name, sysfs path, status and EDID byte length for each matched HDMI entry.

files.meaning: Firmware, initramfs hook and GRUB drop-in path/existence/connector observations.

held_now.meaning: The running command line has the EDID reference and matching forced connector.

edid_firmware_now.meaning: An EDID firmware reference appears in the running command line.

held_now_connector.meaning: The running EDID reference names this connector, if present.

held_next_boot.meaning: The saved GRUB drop-in contains an EDID reference.

mutationPerformed.meaning: The writer reported changed files when it completed; false on a read, plan, no-op or a handled refusal.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when an unexpected fault is reported by the front door instead of the stop.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Absent when the stop emits no signal. The enum lists literal outcomes. Non-token intake or system exceptions are reported as hdmi-hold-read-failed:<exception class>.
